subject.title: refactor(config): config-surface reduction tranche 1 — retire dead keys, dedupe channel schemas, add growth ratchet

question: Should this non-major configuration cleanup retain the published `TelegramDmThreadReplies` type alias until a major-version deprecation removal?
rationale: The implementation can reject the retired runtime field while preserving a type-only SDK compatibility alias, but permanently removing a published Plugin SDK symbol requires an explicit release-contract decision.

options.title: Retain the type-only alias
options.body: Restore a deprecated `TelegramDmThreadReplies` export and cover the published SDK contract while leaving runtime configuration retirement and doctor migration intact.

options.title: Approve a breaking SDK removal
options.body: Treat this PR as an explicitly approved major-version Plugin SDK break and document the required external-plugin upgrade path.

options.title: Split the SDK removal
options.body: Land the config migration separately and defer the public type removal to a versioned SDK-breaking change.

recommendation.title: Retain the type-only alias
recommendation.body: Restore a deprecated `TelegramDmThreadReplies` export and cover the published SDK contract while leaving runtime configuration retirement and doctor migration intact.
